‘Creating excellence – Inspiring Success for all’
On behalf of all the Staff and Governors at Summerside, I would like to offer you a warm welcome to Summerside Primary Academy.
I feel incredibly proud to be the Headteacher of this wonderful school where all of our children love coming to school as they benefit from an exciting, full and rich curriculum and outstanding pastoral care.
Summerside is a special place as a result of our highly diverse community and our inclusive approach. We celebrate children’s different cultural and religious backgrounds and ensure that all children feel included and successful. We are skilled in providing for children who are new to English or have additional needs. Our children are excited to learn and have excellent outcomes as a result.
Our fantastic staff work hard to ensure that all our children have the skills they need and are well prepared for the next stage of their journey. They do this through our carefully planned and exceptional curriculum offer and develop the character of every child.
We are also fortunate to have the Provision for Deaf children for Barnet, based at our school. This specialist provision is an integral part of what makes our school different to others. Our Deaf children are fully integrated into the mainstream setting with support from highly skilled Teachers for the Deaf (TOD) and Communication Support Workers (CSW)All of our children learn to sign in British Sign Language (BSL) and we use sign in our songs.
Thank you for taking the time to have a look at our website and please do spend some time looking at the more detailed information about the exceptional work that we do.
I would love for you to visit us here at Summerside, where I would be more than happy to show you around so you can see our fantastic school and meet our amazing children.

Vision and Values
‘Creating Excellence – Inspiring Success for all’
At Summerside we have a very clear vision for all our children.
Everything that we do is to ensure that our children have the best possible life chances and are ready for the next stage in their development. Our strapline was co-created by every staff member who made a valuable contribution to our ambition for every child of Summerside.
Our exceptional curriculum, is inspiring and exciting for our children and includes many enrichment opportunities and trips into London, therefore enhancing our experiences for children and developing their character. We ensure that at all times we include everyone and find opportunities to celebrate our diversity. The Provision for Children who are Deaf is a key part of Summerside and we are delighted with the progress our children make.
Despite low starting points, the success of our children academically is evident through our outstanding outcomes at the end of KS2. Everyone leaves Summerside well prepared for their Secondary school journey as we work hard to ensure that they are reflective and resilient learners. See here for our latest results.
All our work is underpinned by our values which are an integral part of our life at Summerside. Again, selected with clear intention for our specific community these values are taught and demonstrated through our learning dispositions. We award children for displaying these during our success assemblies.
Vision and Values

Welcome
Our children love coming to Summerside as they benefit from a full and rich curriculum offer and outstanding pastoral care. They are excited about learning new things and make excellent progress as a result. Our staff work hard to ensure that our learners have the skills that they need to succeed in life. Our children care for each other and play safely together. We are proud that children at Summerside are extremely polite and well-behaved.
Summerside is incredibly diverse and we celebrate children’s different cultural backgrounds. We are skilled in providing for children who are new to learning English and have additional needs. We have specialist provision for Deaf children, where children are fully integrated into mainstream classes with specialist support provided by Teachers of the Deaf and Communicators.
You can find out more information about Summerside's curriculum by clicking on the "Curriculum" tab in the top right-hand corner of this page.
If you have trouble reading or accessing any information on this website or information that is provided by the school in other forms, please contact our admin team on 020 8445 1192 or email admin@summersideprimary.co.uk and we will support you in accessing the information in an alternative way. If you need any support or an interpreter at a school meeting, please also contact us and we can arrange this. If you are a parent or carer and are unable to attend a meeting at school due to a disability, please contact Ms Phillips and we will discuss an alternative way with you.
Paper copies of all information contained on our website is available from our school office on request.

Extra-Curricular Clubs & Wrap-Around Childcare
After-school clubs
Planned after-school sports clubs for Autumn Term 1–2026:-
Years 3 & 4 Football
Planned after-school enrichment clubs for Autumn Term 1 & 2 - 2026:-
Please email our office (clubs@summersideprimary.co.uk) to request a place.
BACE Holidays – Free Holiday Activities for Eligible Families Barnet offers BACE Holidays, a programme providing free holiday activities and nutritious meals for children aged 5–16 who receive benefit‑related Free School Meals. Activities include sports, creative arts, cooking, trips, and enrichment opportunities every Spring, Summer and Winter Holidays.
More information and booking: https://barnetyouth.uk/baceholidays
Positive Activities for ALL Barnet Children and Young People Barnet’s Positive Activities programme offers a wide range of free or low‑cost activities for any child or young person who lives in Barnet or attends a Barnet school. Sessions run year‑round (Term-Times and Holidays) and include youth clubs, sports, arts, music, outdoor learning and more.
Explore the full Positive Activities offer: https://barnetyouth.uk/Positive-Activities
Music Lessons
At Summerside, we are delighted to be able to offer children the chance to have either guitar or piano lessons. If you are interested in your child learning either of these instruments, please visit: https://www.pianofunclub.co.uk/ for more information and to book lessons.
Breakfast club
Breakfast club is for children from Reception to Year 6 and costs £4.00 per day (paid through School Money) and includes a healthy breakfast of cereal, toast, fruit, yogurt and squash. Children play games inside and outside school. Children can come every day or for occasional days as needed and places do not need to be booked in advance. Please bring your child to the Breakfast Club door between 8:00 and 8:15.
Children who have Free School Meals due to family income can come to Breakfast Club free of charge.
After-school childcare
Happy Days After School Club at Summerside School
Happy Days After School Club, based in Summerside School, continues to look after your child(ren), providing activities in the club daily, Monday to Friday from 3.30 pm - 6.00pm.
If you would like your child to join the Club and engage in the activities, we are happy to speak with you and spaces are available for bookings. You can book your child online weekly, specify regular days and book ad hoc sessions suited to your individual needs.
Please go to our newly updated website, www.happydaysclubs.uk where you can simply register.
You can also register and then book ad hoc sessions on:-
https://happydaysclubs.ipalbookings.com
£15.00 per session/day.
£15.00 per day for regular full-time booked weekly sessions Monday to Friday.
£15.00 for ad hoc sessions (48hrs notice required) in advance and booking fee applies).
£17.00 for ad hoc sessions (without 48hrs notice in advance will incur booking and late fee)
One hour is £11.50 or £13.50 if under 48 hours.
Please note, you may also be entitled to help with Childcare costs https://www.gov.uk/help-with-childcare-costs as we are Ofsted Registered.
Childcare at school – You can only get help paying for care that is outside school hours, for example after-school clubs or breakfast clubs. Please check if you qualify by clicking on the link below:
https://www.gov.uk/childcare-calculator?step-by-step-nav=f237ec8e-e82c-4ffa-8fba-2a88a739783b. We accept government assisted funds for childcare expenses and other childcare vouchers etc.
We welcome your booking with us and if you have any queries, please contact us – emailing Maria Flannery on maria@happydaysclubs.uk.
Manager– Happy Days Clubs
